'''Kun Yang''' ({{zh|杨昆}};<ref name=fudan20111205>[http://www.fudan.edu.cn/fudannews/2011/1205/29581.html 朱晓阳、杨昆、黄旦洪三位校友当选美国物理学会会士（APS Fellow）] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303230317/http://www.fudan.edu.cn/fudannews/2011/1205/29581.html |date=2016-03-03}} - 综合新闻 - [[Fudan University|复旦大学]]</ref> born 1967), is a Chinese physicist. 

He received a bachelor of science from [[Fudan University]] in 1989.<ref name=fudan20111205/>
In 1994 he got his Ph.D. in the [[condensed matter theory]] from the [[Indiana University Bloomington]]. From 1994 to 1997, he worked as a postdoctoral research associate at [[Princeton University]] and from 1997 to 1999, he was the [[Sherman Fairchild]]'s senior research fellow at [[California Institute of Technology]]. He joined the faculty of [[Florida State University]] in 1999 and since then dedicated his life to study [[unconventional superconductor]]s and [[quantum magnetism]].{{citation needed|date=December 2013}} Currently{{when|date=August 2024}} he is a professor at the Florida State University<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.physics.fsu.edu/people/personnel.asp?fn=Kun&ln=Yang|title=Kun Yang|publisher=Florida State University|accessdate=December 27, 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131227091310/http://www.physics.fsu.edu/people/personnel.asp?fn=Kun&ln=Yang|archive-date=2013-12-27|url-status=dead}}</ref> and is an author of over 80 [[peer-review]]ed articles.
